notes.title: The Final Chapter
notes.notes:
A totally new adventure for Baldo set at the end of The Guardian Owls.
The Final Chapter

A new journey for Baldo connoisseurs who love the thrill of exploration.
A captivating adventure in search of intriguing new mysteries, packed with puzzles to solve and secrets to unravel.

notes.title: The Elemental Temples

The Elemental Temples.

A new journey for Baldo connoisseurs who love the thrill of exploration.
A captivating adventure in search of intriguing new temples, packed with puzzles to solve and secrets to unravel.

notes.title: The Three Fairies
notes.notes:
A totally new adventure for Baldo set in Asoka Village, The Three Fairies.

New Assisted mode :
Any time in the options menu you can activate the (assisted mode) to facilitate the game.
Your health and Orbs will recharge slowly and more pinpoints will be shown on the map.

notes.title: Nominate "Baldo The Guardian Owls"
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers

Nominations for the Steam Awards are open.

If you love Baldo The Guardian Owls and would like to nominee it please vote it for "Outstanding Visual Style Award" category.
